description: Run one Gotify action: health, version, me, messages, applications, clients, status, send, create_application, update_application, create_client, delete_message, delete_all_messages, delete_application, delete_client, or help.

action.description: Action to run: health, version, me, messages, applications, clients, status, send, create_application, update_application, create_client, or delete_message.

app_id.description: Application id, for the update_application action.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm a destructive action such as delete_message.

default_priority.description: Default message priority for the application.

description.description: Application description, for the create_application and update_application actions.

extras.description: Extras object attached to the message, for the send action.

id.description: Message id, for the delete_message action.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return, for the messages action.

message.description: Message text, for the send action.

name.description: Application or client name, for the create and update actions.

priority.description: Message priority as an integer, for the send action.

since.description: Only return messages with an id greater than this value, for the messages action.

title.description: Message title, for the send action.

name: gotify
